in_marathi.name: Madesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Measures
in_marathi.long_meaning: Madesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Madesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Mada', which means 'measure'. The name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is often referred to as the 'Lord of Measures'. It signifies precision, accuracy, and balance.
